source_passage: Confirmed medium-severity breach: an Aug 2022 phishing attack gave an attacker access to a single file server at the Corindi (NSW) berry site, with ~10% of that server's data accessed and encrypted; sensitive employee PII potentially exposed (passports, birth certificates, citizenship certificates, bank/super details, TFNs). Notified to ACSC and OAIC. Confirmed incident and PII exposure raise amenability, but agriculture/horticulture is a lower-data-sensitivity sector, no customer/supplier data was impacted, and the incident is dated (2022) — netting to Medium. PE-owned (delisted), so cyber-insurance decisions sit with the consortium. Aug 2022 phishing breach at Corindi (NSW) berry site: ~10% of one file server accessed and encrypted; employee PII (passports, bank, super, TFN, citizenship/birth/travel docs) potentially exposed; notified to ACSC and OAIC; no ransom disclosed Independent corroboration (BankInfoSecurity) of the phishing attack, employee-PII exposure and service disruptions; no customer/supplier data breached; no threat group attributed Parent/controlling owner: Paine Schwartz Partners (led ~A$1.5bn equity buyout, completed Feb 2024, delisted) Co-owner + long-standing 50/50 berry JV partner: Driscoll's Inc. ('coopetition') Co-owner/institutional investor: British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) Major customers (~75% of produce sales combined): Woolworths, Coles, ALDI, Metcash Auditor: KPMG (NOT PwC) Competitors (lower-credibility source): Perfection Fresh, Mildura Fruit Co, Nutrano/2PH, Berry Exchange; international Dole/Del Monte
triples: was not impacted by customer/supplier data
